reading.zh: 从左到右的信号链：滤波器与积分分离提供基础信号处理 → EKF 观测风扰 → 前馈 PID 把扰动补偿进位置控制；RRT* 独立负责路径规划。
reading.en: Left-to-right signal chain: filters and integral separation provide base signal conditioning, the EKF observes wind disturbance, and the feedforward PID folds that compensation into position control; RRT* plans paths independently.
